in_marathi.name: सूरज
in_marathi.long_meaning: सूरज हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name सूरज is derived from Sanskrit, meaning 'Sun God'. In Hindu mythology, the sun is a symbol of power, energy, and life. The god Surya is revered for his strength, wisdom, and the ability to give life.
